name: detcoef2
expr: h1 = detcoef2('h', C, S, 1); v1 = detcoef2('v', C, S, 1); d1 = detcoef2('d', C, S, 1); h2 = detcoef2('h', C, S, 2); hs = detcoef2('h', single(C), S, 1); hu = detcoef2('h', uint16(abs(C)), S, 1); hl = detcoef2('h', logical(C~=0), S, 1); hx = detcoef2('h', complex(C,1), S, 1);
comment: Sig: D = detcoef2(type, C, S, level) / [H,V,D] = detcoef2('all', C, S, level). Argcheck portion 2026-09-19: C is a FREE GATHER - every numeric class plus complex passes with the class preserved in the result (single = single, uint16 = uint16, logical = logical, complex = complex); S must be real numeric (char/complex reject, probed R2025b). Branches: h/v/d at levels 1-2, class preservation x4.
